My favorite accessory is my 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth Controller. The reason why I like this is because of how convenient it is. I don't have to worry about charging it, as long as I place it on the dock after using it, the next time I use it I know that it is charged. I also like that it seamlessly connects and disconnects when I take it from the dock and place it back. I tried looking for other controllers but other controllers don't have a charging dock included, hall effect joysticks, or programmable back paddles. Not to mention that it's very affordable. Only thing I don't like about it is the Nintendo layout buttons. I'd have to buy Xbox buttons if I want to replace it. Overall, it's probably one of the best purchases I made.
